knowledge_tree.title: Selective Compulsory English Book 1
knowledge_tree.content: High school English textbook focusing on themes like people of achievement, future technology, parks, body language, and agriculture.

children.title: Unit 1: People of Achievement
children.content: Focuses on notable figures and their contributions, using descriptive language and non-restrictive relative clauses.

children.title: Reading and Thinking
children.content: Techniques for reading about people of achievement, including skimming, scanning, and identifying descriptive words.

children.title: Descriptive Words
children.content: Words that help form a better impression of the subject described.

children.title: Text Purpose and Audience
children.content: Identifying the purpose and intended audience of a passage.

children.title: Non-Restrictive Relative Clauses
children.content: Clauses that provide additional information without restricting the meaning of the sentence.

children.title: Definition and Function
children.content: Non-restrictive relative clauses add extra information and are set off by commas.

children.title: Examples and Usage
children.content: Using non-restrictive clauses to give additional details about a noun.

children.title: Vocabulary Building
children.content: Words related to scientific research, achievements, and personal qualities.

children.content: Discussing great people, giving time to think, and sharing opinions.

children.title: Giving Time to Think

children.title: Sharing Opinions
children.content: Expressing personal views on greatness and achievements.

children.title: Writing
children.content: Writing an introduction about someone admired, focusing on structure and language features.

children.title: Structure of an Introduction
children.content: Including appearance, life story, reasons for admiration, and personal feelings.

children.title: Language Features
children.content: Using descriptive language and rhetorical devices.

children.title: Unit 2: Looking into the Future
children.content: Explores future technologies like smart homes, AI, and their impacts.

children.title: Smart Homes
children.content: Homes with integrated technology for automatic control, health monitoring, and disaster prevention.

children.title: Intelligent Controls
children.content: Automated systems for energy efficiency and routine management.

children.title: Health Monitoring
children.content: Beds and toilets that track health and provide suggestions.

children.title: Disaster Prevention
children.content: Detecting leaks and electrical issues to prevent damage.

children.title: Future Progressive Tense
children.content: Used to describe ongoing actions in the future.

children.title: Formation and Usage
children.content: Will be + present participle to indicate future ongoing actions.

children.title: Examples
children.content: e.g., 'In the future, we will be using advanced technology every day.'

children.title: Unit 3: Fascinating Parks
children.content: Covers national parks and theme parks, their features, and experiences.

children.title: National Parks
children.content: Protected natural areas like Sarek National Park, focusing on conservation and human interaction.

children.title: Sarek National Park
children.content: A remote park in Sweden with glaciers, reindeer, and Sami people.

children.title: Conservation Efforts
children.content: Measures to maintain natural state and limit development.

children.title: Theme Parks
children.content: Parks like Disneyland, Dollywood, and Chimelong Ocean Kingdom, offering entertainment and education.

children.title: Disneyland
children.content: Magical world with characters, rides, and parades.

children.title: Dollywood
children.content: Celebrates American southeastern culture with music, crafts, and rides.

children.title: Chimelong Ocean Kingdom
children.content: Ocean-themed park with aquariums, animal shows, and rides.

children.title: As Predicative
